messages:
Mira: quick async standup — kernel latch/batcher perf check
Mira: Yesterday: landed PR that switches batcher lock to sharded latch; reduced contention when 8+ inflight streams. Local microbench (seq=256) p95 down from 38ms -> 35.5ms (~7%).
Mira: Blockers: on multi-tenant perf smoke I saw KV cache eviction bursts when small concurrent requests spike (seen on canary2). Eviction rate jumps ~3x and tail latency spikes.
Mira: Today: running 50-node perf sweep across model variants (mpt-7b, bloom-3b) and enabling async_rounds=4 on canary; will open a follow-up PR for adaptive eviction thresholds.
Sam: thx — can you drop the perf logs in bench-bot? Also pinged infra to add 2 more canary hosts :thumbsup:
Jen: re: eviction bursts — are you using TTL-based eviction or size-based? Last week I changed eviction policy to size-first for small shards.
Mira: it's size-first atm. suspect small-request churn plus shard imbalance. plan to try TTL bump + per-tenant cap.
Leo: for the 50-node run, FYI I changed kernel's batch window to 6ms on canary; might affect p95. If it's noisy, revert to 4ms.
Sam: here's quick extract from last canary logs — eviction spike at 1678923. sample:
```
[2026-03-08T14:22:11Z] evict: tenant=acme shard=7 evicted=120 rate=3.1/s p95_lat=98ms
[2026-03-08T14:22:12Z] batcher: shard=7 inflight=12 latch_wait=4.8ms
```
Sam: leaving it in bench-bot channel.
Mira: @Leo thanks — I'll run with 4ms and then try 6ms in a follow-up. @Sam ping me once infra adds hosts.
Jen: I'll review the PR, quick note: please add unit test for latch fairness and a small perf harness snippet.
Mira: will do. PR #214 is open, adding tests + perf snippet. ETA EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
bench-bot: perf job queued (job id jb-8842). Results will post here when done.
Leo: if perf is stable, let's schedule a canary rollout to prod-dedicated tomorrow morning.
Mira: +1. If eviction persists we'll hold and try per-tenant caps first.
Sam: OK, re infra — added hosts, bench-bot should pick them up in 2m :rocket:
Mira: awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
